intelligence.essence: My Code is the promise my whole world runs on — my mission, my constitution, my laws, my privacy promise, and my design standard, all in one place. Its first rule is simple: do no harm, create real value, and respect every person. If you want to know what I stand for, start here.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a clubhouse where the rules are painted on the wall for everyone to see: be kind, do not take what is not yours, and help each other out. My Code is those rules for my whole world, and everyone can read them. Nobody has to guess how they will be treated here.
intelligence.grandma_view: When I was young, a handshake was your word, and your word was everything. My Code is my handshake written down — I will do you no harm, I will respect you, and I will keep your private things private.
